name: Save campaign subject
description: Call this when you need to update the subject line (and preheader) of an existing email campaign in the editor. Use the action to create a new campaign instead when the campaign does not yet exist.
preconditions: The campaign with the given ID must already exist.

campaign_id.description: Identifier of the email campaign to update (the :id part of the URL).

subject.description: The new subject line for the campaign.

preheaderSetup.description: The preheader text associated with the campaign.

subjectLineSource.description: Indicates how the subject line was set; currently only 'manual' is supported.

subjectModifiedAfterAIUse.description: Flag indicating whether the subject was edited after any AI‑generated suggestion.

side_effects: The campaign's subject line and preheader are updated.
